items.text: Good morning. How are you doing today?
I would like a cup of coffee, please.
Could you say that again, a little more slowly?
items.zh: 你能再说一遍吗，稍微慢一点？

items.text: Thank you very much for your help.
I usually walk to work in the morning.
items.zh: 我早上通常步行去上班。

items.text: What time does the meeting start?
The weather is really nice today.

items.zh: 抱歉，我没听清你的名字。

items.text: Let me check my schedule and get back to you.
items.zh: 我看一下日程，然后回复你。

items.text: Where can I find the nearest bus stop?
She works at a hospital near the river.
items.zh: 她在河边的一家医院工作。

items.text: This is the third time I have tried it.
Please turn right at the traffic light.
I think we should leave a little earlier.
items.zh: 我觉得我们应该早点出发。

items.text: How much does this one cost?
Everything is going well so far.

groups.title: 短段落 · 我的一天

items.text: I get up at six thirty every morning. After a quick shower, I make a cup of tea and read the news for ten minutes. Then I walk to the bus stop, which is only three blocks away. The ride takes about twenty minutes, so I usually listen to an English podcast on the way.
items.zh: 我每天早上六点半起床。快速洗完澡后，我泡一杯茶，看十分钟新闻。然后步行去公交站，只有三个街区远。车程大约二十分钟，所以我通常在路上听英语播客。

items.text: My family lives in a small apartment near the park. On Saturday morning, we walk there together and watch the children play. My father likes to sit under the big tree and read, while my mother takes photos of the flowers. It is a simple habit, but it makes the whole week feel lighter.
items.zh: 我家住在公园附近的小公寓里。周六早上，我们一起走过去，看孩子们玩。我父亲喜欢坐在大树下看书，母亲则给花拍照。这是个简单的习惯，却让整个星期都轻松了些。

groups.title: 工作沟通句

items.text: Could you walk me through the main issues before the meeting?
items.zh: 开会前你能先带我过一下主要问题吗？

items.text: We are still waiting for the supplier to confirm the delivery date.
items.zh: 我们还在等供应商确认交期。

items.text: I'd appreciate it if you could send the report by Thursday.
items.zh: 如果你能在周四前把报告发来，我会很感激。

items.text: Let's break this problem down into three smaller parts.
items.zh: 我们把这个问题拆成三个小部分。

items.text: The results were not exactly what we expected, but they are useful.
items.zh: 结果并不完全符合预期，但很有价值。

items.text: Please double-check the numbers before we publish them.
items.zh: 在发布之前请再核对一遍数据。

items.text: I'm not sure I follow. Could you give me an example?
items.zh: 我不太明白，你能举个例子吗？

items.text: Once the design is approved, we can start production next week.
items.zh: 设计一经批准，我们下周就能开始生产。

groups.title: 工程 · 技术沟通句

items.text: The tolerance on this dimension is plus or minus zero point zero two millimeters.
items.zh: 这个尺寸的公差是正负零点零二毫米。

items.text: We need to increase the draft angle to avoid drag marks during ejection.
items.zh: 我们需要加大脱模斜度，避免顶出时产生拉伤。

items.text: Please confirm the parting line before we start machining the cavity.
items.zh: 在开始加工型腔前请确认分型面。

items.text: The shrinkage rate of this material is about zero point five percent.
items.zh: 这种材料的收缩率大约是百分之零点五。

items.text: We found some flash along the parting line after the first trial run.
items.zh: 第一次试模后我们在分型面上发现了一些飞边。

items.text: The mold will be ready for the T1 trial next Friday.
items.zh: 模具将在下周五准备好进行 T1 试模。

items.text: Could you send me the updated drawing with the revised dimensions?
items.zh: 你能把更新后带修改尺寸的图纸发给我吗？

items.text: The surface finish should reach mirror polish on the cosmetic side.
items.zh: 外观面的表面处理需要达到镜面抛光。

items.text: We adjusted the cooling channels to reduce the cycle time by four seconds.
items.zh: 我们调整了冷却水路，把成型周期缩短了四秒。

items.text: The warpage is caused by uneven wall thickness in this region.
items.zh: 这个区域的变形是由壁厚不均造成的。

groups.title: 段落 · 技术说明

items.text: Injection molding looks simple from the outside: melt the plastic, push it into a mold, and let it cool. In practice, almost every defect comes from a balance problem. If the gate is too small, the pressure rises and the part shows flow marks. If the cooling is uneven, one side shrinks faster than the other and the part warps. A good engineer spends most of the time not on the machine, but on the thinking before the machine runs.
items.zh: 注塑从外面看很简单：把塑料熔化，注入模具，然后冷却。实际上，几乎每种缺陷都来自平衡问题。浇口太小，压力升高，产品出现流痕；冷却不均，一侧收缩快于另一侧，产品就会变形。好的工程师大部分时间不是花在机器上，而是花在机器运行之前的思考上。

items.text: When we review a new project, we always start with three questions. What does the customer actually measure? Which dimensions carry the function, and which are only cosmetic? And where will the tooling wear out first? Answering these questions early saves far more money than optimizing the cycle time later.
items.zh: 评审新项目时，我们总是从三个问题开始：客户真正测量什么？哪些尺寸承担功能，哪些只是外观？模具最先会在哪里磨损？早点回答这些问题，比后期优化成型周期省钱得多。

groups.title: 外贸 · 询盘与报价
groups.desc: 模具出口：询价、报价、交期沟通

items.text: We are looking for a reliable tooling supplier for injection molds. Please advise your capacity.
items.zh: 我们在找可靠的注塑模具供应商，请告知贵司产能。

items.text: Could you send us a quotation for the attached plastic part, including mold cost and unit price?
items.zh: 请就附件塑件报价，含模具费与单价。

items.text: Our annual volume is around one hundred thousand pieces. What is your best unit price?
items.zh: 我司年用量约十万件，最低单价多少？

items.text: The mold cost is eight thousand US dollars for a single-cavity H13 steel mold.
items.zh: 单穴 H13 钢模费用八千美元。

items.text: This quotation is valid for thirty days from the date of issue.
items.zh: 本报价自发函日起三十天内有效。

items.text: Tooling lead time is about five weeks, including the first trial shot.
items.zh: 模具周期约五周，含首次试模。

items.text: Can you build the mold with a cold runner, or do you recommend a hot runner?
items.zh: 模具做冷流道，还是你建议热流道？

items.text: We need the mold to be compatible with our existing injection machine, tonnage three hundred fifty tons.
items.zh: 模具需适配我司现有注塑机，吨位 350 吨。

items.text: Please quote both DHL sample freight and sea freight for the mass production.
items.zh: 请分别报 DHL 样品运费与量产海运运费。

items.text: If we place the order this month, can you keep the quoted price for the whole project?
items.zh: 若本月下单，能否整个项目都按此报价？

groups.title: 外贸 · 付款与模具周期
groups.desc: 付款条件、开模进度、量产交期

items.text: Our payment terms are fifty percent deposit upon PO, fifty percent before shipment.
items.zh: 付款条件：下单付 50% 定金，发货前付 50%。

items.text: The mold cost is to be paid one hundred percent in advance by T/T.
items.zh: 模具费需 100% 电汇预付。

items.text: We will arrange the deposit after the quotation is confirmed.
items.zh: 报价确认后我们安排定金。

items.text: Tooling will start within three working days after the deposit is received.
items.zh: 定金到账后三个工作日内开始开模。

items.text: We expect to provide T1 samples within four weeks after deposit.
items.zh: 定金后四周内出 T1 样品。

items.text: The mold is guaranteed for five hundred thousand shots with proper maintenance.
items.zh: 模具在正常维护下保用五十万模次。

items.text: Mass production lead time is fifteen days after sample approval.
items.zh: 样品确认后量产交期十五天。

items.text: Please note the balance must be cleared before we book the vessel.
items.zh: 请注意尾款需在订舱前结清。

items.text: We accept irrevocable L/C at sight for orders above fifty thousand US dollars.
items.zh: 五万美元以上订单可接受即期不可撤销信用证。

items.text: Could you share the tooling progress report every Friday?
items.zh: 能否每周五一发模具进度报告？

groups.title: 外贸 · 试模验货与出货
groups.desc: 首件检验、缺陷、出货与单证

items.text: First Article Inspection per PPAP is required before mass production.
items.zh: 量产前需按 PPAP 做首件检验。

items.text: Please submit the dimensional report and material certificate with the samples.
items.zh: 请随样品提供尺寸报告与材质证明。

items.text: We found some flash along the parting line after the first trial run.
items.zh: 首次试模后分型面有飞边。

items.text: The parts show short shot at the far end of the cavity.
Please send the T1 samples by DHL with the inspection report.
items.zh: T1 样品随检验报告用 DHL 寄出。

items.text: Goods will be shipped FOB Ningbo; you arrange the international freight.
items.zh: 货物 FOB 宁波，国际运费由贵司安排。

items.text: We need a full container load, about twenty cubic meters.
items.zh: 我们要整柜，约 20 立方。

items.text: Please use seaworthy export plywood cases with moisture-proof lining.
items.zh: 请用适航出口胶合板箱的防潮内衬。

items.text: The carton must show the part number, quantity, and our PO number.
items.zh: 纸箱须标零件号、数量与我司采购单号。

items.text: Could you book the earliest vessel and send the draft B/L for approval?
items.zh: 请订最早船期并传提单草件确认？

groups.title: 外贸 · 客诉与索赔
groups.desc: 不良处理、8D 改善、索赔沟通

items.text: We received the parts, but about five percent show warpage.
The molded parts have visible sink marks on the surface.
Dimensional inspection found the boss diameter is out of tolerance.
items.zh: 尺寸检验发现凸台直径超差。

items.text: Please provide an eight-D corrective action report within five days.
items.zh: 请五日内提交 8D 改善报告。

items.text: We need a containment plan to sort the affected stock immediately.
items.zh: 需立即对受影响库存做挑选的围堵方案。

items.text: The root cause seems to be insufficient packing pressure.
items.zh: 根本原因疑似保压不足。

items.text: Can you rework the remaining parts or should we scrap them?
items.zh: 剩余件是返工还是报废？

items.text: We may claim the tooling rework cost if the defect is mold-related.
items.zh: 若缺陷属模具原因，我方可能索赔修模费。

items.text: Please confirm the corrective action before the next shipment.
items.zh: 下次出货前请确认改善措施。

items.text: We appreciate your quick response and hope to close this issue soon.
items.zh: 感谢快速回复，望尽快关闭此问题。

groups.title: 外贸 · 邮件段落
groups.desc: 真实业务邮件段落，练长句节奏

items.text: Dear Supplier, we are a manufacturer of automotive plastic components and plan to outsource two new injection molds this quarter. Please quote based on the attached 3D drawings, including mold cost, unit price at annual volume one hundred thousand pieces, and tooling lead time. We prefer H13 steel with a hot runner system. Payment would be fifty percent deposit and fifty percent before shipment. Looking forward to your quotation.
items.zh: 尊敬的供应商：我司为汽车塑件制造商，本季度计划外发两套新注塑模具。请依据附件 3D 图报价，含模具费、年量十万件单价及开模周期。我们倾向 H13 钢加热流道。付款为 50% 定金、发货前 50%。盼复报价。

items.text: We received lot number A2409 last week and found about five percent of the parts warped, with sink marks on the boss. Dimensional check shows the boss diameter is zero point one millimeter over tolerance. This looks like a molding process issue rather than a design change. Please submit an 8D report within five days, and propose a containment plan to sort the current stock. We may claim the rework cost if the root cause is confirmed as mold-related.
items.zh: 上周收到批次 A2409，约 5% 塑件变形，凸台有缩痕。尺寸检测凸台直径超差 0.1 毫米。这像是成型工艺问题而非设计变更。请五日内提交 8D 报告，并提出围堵方案挑选现有库存。若根因确认属模具问题，我方可能索赔返工费。

levels.name: 高级
levels.desc: 长句与篇章，练语调、意群、连读与弱读。

groups.title: 长句 · 意群与重音

items.text: What surprised me most was not the result itself, but how quickly everyone accepted it.
items.zh: 最让我惊讶的不是结果本身，而是所有人接受它的速度。

items.text: If we had known the material would behave differently at low temperature, we would have redesigned the rib.
items.zh: 如果早知道这种材料在低温下表现不同，我们就会重新设计加强筋。

items.text: Instead of asking whether the plan is perfect, ask whether it is good enough to start.
items.zh: 不要问计划是否完美，而要问它是否足够好到可以开始。

items.text: The report suggests that, over the past decade, productivity has grown faster than wages.
items.zh: 报告表明，过去十年生产率的增长快于工资增长。

items.text: Honestly, I think we are solving the wrong problem, and solving it very efficiently.
items.zh: 说实话，我认为我们在解决错误的问题，而且解决得非常高效。

items.text: Whatever you decide, please make sure the team hears it from you first.
items.zh: 无论你决定什么，请确保团队先从你这里听到。

groups.title: 篇章 · 观点表达

items.text: There is an old idea in engineering that you cannot improve what you do not measure. I would add a second half to it: you also cannot improve what you measure badly. Numbers give us confidence, and confidence is exactly what makes us stop asking questions. So before trusting a chart, I always try to find out how the data was collected, who collected it, and what was quietly left out.
items.zh: 工程界有句老话：无法度量的东西无法改进。我想补上后半句：度量得糟糕的东西同样无法改进。数字给我们信心，而信心恰恰让我们停止追问。所以在相信一张图表之前，我总会先弄清数据是怎么采集的、谁采集的，以及哪些东西被悄悄忽略了。

items.text: Learning a language as an adult is mostly an exercise in tolerating discomfort. Your ear knows the sound is wrong long before your mouth can fix it, and that gap feels like failure. It is not. It is the feedback loop doing its job. The people who improve fastest are not the ones with the best accent on day one, but the ones who are willing to sound strange for a few months.
items.zh: 成年人学语言，主要是一种忍受不适的训练。你的耳朵早就知道音不对，而嘴巴还改不过来，这个落差让人觉得像失败。其实不是。那正是反馈回路在起作用。进步最快的人，不是第一天口音最好的人，而是愿意在几个月里听起来怪怪的人。

items.text: When a project runs late, the first instinct is to add more people. But adding people to a late project usually makes it later, because the cost of communication grows faster than the amount of work being shared. What actually helps is cutting scope, clarifying ownership, and being honest about the date, even when honesty is expensive.
items.zh: 项目延期时，第一反应往往是加人。但给延期项目加人通常会让它更晚，因为沟通成本的增长快于被分担的工作量。真正有效的是缩减范围、明确责任，以及对交期保持诚实——即使诚实的代价很高。

groups.title: 长句 · 从句嵌套

items.text: The engineer who designed the bridge that failed in the storm was later proved right about the wind.
items.zh: 那位设计了在风暴中垮塌的大桥的工程师，后来被证明他对风的判断是对的。

items.text: What few people realized was that the machine had been running without proper maintenance for eleven months.
items.zh: 很少有人意识到，这台机器已经连续十一个月没有做过妥善维护了。

items.text: Although the data looked convincing, the researchers admitted that they could not explain three of the anomalies.
items.zh: 尽管数据看起来很有说服力，研究者承认其中三处异常他们无法解释。

items.text: The question is not whether we can build it, but whether we can build it safely enough to trust.
items.zh: 问题不在于我们能不能造出来，而在于能不能造得足够安全、值得信任。

items.text: Anyone who has ever managed a team knows that the hardest part is not the plan, it is the people.
items.zh: 任何带过团队的人都知道，最难的不是计划，而是人。

items.text: It was only after the third failed attempt that they finally understood why the original design had worked.
items.zh: 直到第三次尝试失败后，他们才终于明白最初的设计为什么能奏效。

groups.title: 长句 · 插入语与破折号

items.text: The policy — controversial from the very start — was quietly dropped after only six weeks.
items.zh: 那项政策——从一开始就充满争议——仅仅六周后就被悄悄废止了。

items.text: My colleague, who has spent fifteen years in this field, still says the simplest answer is usually the right one.
items.zh: 我的同事在这个领域待了十五年，他仍然说最简单的答案通常是对的。

items.text: There is, I think, a real difference between being busy and being productive.
items.zh: 我认为，“忙碌”和“有产出”之间确实存在差别。

items.text: The results, though still preliminary, suggest a pattern we have seen before in much colder climates.
items.zh: 这些结果虽然仍是初步的，但呈现出一种我们此前在更寒冷地区见过的规律。

items.text: He paused — just for a second — and then answered the question nobody wanted to ask.
items.zh: 他停顿了一下——只有一秒——然后回答了那个谁都不想问的问题。

items.text: Success, whatever definition you prefer, rarely arrives on the schedule you imagined.
items.zh: 无论你偏好哪种定义，成功很少会按你设想的时间表到来。

groups.title: 长句 · 倒装与强调

items.text: Not until the very last minute did anyone notice that the numbers simply did not add up.
items.zh: 直到最后一刻，才有人注意到这些数字根本对不上。

items.text: Only by failing twice did she discover the approach that finally worked.
items.zh: 正是在失败两次之后，她才找到最终奏效的方法。

items.text: Seldom has a single decision changed so much so quickly.
items.zh: 很少有哪个决定能如此迅速地带來如此巨大的改变。

items.text: What I want is not more options; what I want is a better default.
items.zh: 我想要的不是更多选项，而是一个更好的默认设置。

items.text: It is patience, not talent, that separates people who finish from people who quit.
items.zh: 把坚持到底的人和半途而废的人区分开的，是耐心，而不是天赋。

items.text: Never before had the team been so certain and so completely wrong.
items.zh: 这支团队从未如此确信，也从未错得如此彻底。

groups.title: 长句 · 学术与新闻语体

items.text: According to the study, published last month, children who read aloud daily scored significantly higher on comprehension tests.
items.zh: 根据上月发表的这项研究，每天朗读的孩子在理解测试中得分明显更高。

items.text: While the overall economy grew by two percent, wages in manufacturing barely moved, which frustrated a great many workers.
items.zh: 虽然整体经济增长了百分之二，制造业的工资几乎没动，这让很多工人感到失望。

items.text: Officials said the delay was caused by a combination of bad weather, staffing shortages, and an outdated scheduling system.
items.zh: 官方表示，延误是恶劣天气、人手短缺和陈旧的调度系统共同造成的。

items.text: The authors argue that the effect is real but small, and that it disappears once income is taken into account.
items.zh: 作者认为这一效应真实存在但很小，并且一旦把收入纳入考量，它就消失了。

items.text: Between 2010 and 2020, the number of households with access to high-speed internet roughly doubled.
items.zh: 2010 到 2020 年间，能使用高速宽带的家庭数量大约翻了一番。

items.text: If current trends continue, the region will need roughly forty percent more water by the year 2035.
items.zh: 如果目前的趋势持续，到 2035 年该地区将需要多出约百分之四十的水。

groups.title: 长段落 · 演讲与播报

items.text: Let me start with a confession. For years I believed that speaking clearly was mostly a matter of talent: you either had a good voice or you did not. Then I spent six months recording myself every single morning, and I discovered something uncomfortable. The problem was never my voice. The problem was that I was trying to say too much in one breath, and I was swallowing the ends of my sentences.
items.zh: 先坦白一件事。多年来我一直认为，说得清楚主要是天赋问题：你要么有一副好嗓子，要么没有。后来我花了六个月，每天早上给自己录音，发现了一件令人不安的事。问题从来不在我的嗓音，而在于我总想一口气说太多，而且吞掉了句子的结尾。

items.text: Good evening. Our top story tonight: a powerful storm moved through the coastal region late last night, leaving more than twelve thousand homes without power. Crews have been working since four this morning, and the company says most customers should have electricity back by tomorrow evening. Residents in the three hardest-hit towns are being asked to stay off the roads until debris has been cleared.
items.zh: 晚上好。今晚头条：一场强风暴于昨夜穿过沿海地区，导致超过一万两千户家庭断电。抢修队从今早四点起持续作业，电力公司表示大多数用户应在明晚前恢复供电。受灾最重的三个镇的居民请尽量不要上路，直到残骸清理完毕。

items.text: The letter arrived on a Tuesday, which I remember because it was raining and I had just missed the bus. I read it twice on the doorstep, then once more at the kitchen table, and I still could not believe what it said. After all those months of waiting, the answer had finally come — and it was not the one I had been preparing for.
items.zh: 信是星期二到的，我记得很清楚，因为那天下着雨，而我刚刚错过了公交车。我在门口读了两遍，又在厨房桌上读了一遍，仍然不敢相信上面写的话。等了那么多个月，答案终于来了——却不是我一直准备好接受的那个。

items.zh: 你好，我是一名学生。我叫汤姆。我每天早上上学。我的老师和蔼，同学友善。我喜欢向每个人问好。学校对我来说是快乐的地方。

The teacher writes on the blackboard.

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: I have many school things. There are books, pencils, a ruler and an eraser in my bag. I use a sharpener to make my pencil sharp. I also have a box of crayons for art class. I take good care of my school things.
items.zh: 我有很多学习用品。书包里有书、铅笔、尺子和橡皮。我用卷笔刀把铅笔削尖。我还有一盒蜡笔上美术课。我很爱惜我的学习用品。

items.zh: 我们每天晚上一起吃晚饭。

groups.title: 人教版 PEP（三起） · 家庭与朋友 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: My family is big and warm. I live with my father, my mother, my brother and my sister. My grandpa and grandma live near us and we visit them on Sundays. My uncle and aunt often send me gifts. I love spending time together with my family.
items.zh: 我的家庭又大又温暖。我和爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、姐姐住在一起。爷爷奶奶住得近，我们周日去看他们。叔叔和姑姑常给我寄礼物。我喜欢和家人共度时光。

items.zh: 我早餐吃面条和一个鸡蛋。

items.text: My mother makes dumplings for dinner.
Would you like some rice and soup?

groups.title: 人教版 PEP（三起） · 食物与饮食 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: I like Chinese food very much. For breakfast I usually have noodles, an egg and a bowl of soup. At dinner my family eats rice, meat and vegetables. On festivals my mother makes dumplings for us. Home cooking is always the best.
items.zh: 我非常喜欢中国菜。早餐我通常吃面条、一个鸡蛋和一碗汤。晚餐我们家吃米饭、肉和蔬菜。过节时妈妈给我们包饺子。家常菜总是最好的。

items.text: Many animals live in the forest.

groups.title: 人教版 PEP（三起） · 动物与自然 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Nature is full of life. In the forest there are tigers, monkeys and many birds. In the river the fish swim freely. Rabbits run on the grass and elephants walk slowly. We should love and protect nature so that animals can live happily.
items.zh: 大自然充满生机。森林里有老虎、猴子和许多鸟。鱼在河里自由地游。兔子在草地上跑，大象慢慢地走。我们应该热爱并保护大自然，让动物们快乐地生活。

groups.title: 外研社（一起/三起） · 天气与季节 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: The weather changes with the seasons. Spring is warm and windy. Summer is hot and sunny. Autumn is cool and the leaves turn yellow. Winter is cold and it often snows. I enjoy every season of the year.
items.zh: 天气随季节变化。春天温暖有风。夏天炎热晴朗。秋天凉爽，树叶变黄。冬天寒冷且常下雪。我享受一年中的每个季节。

items.zh: 红色和白色混合成粉色。

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: There are many colours around us. The sky is blue and the grass is green. My favourite colour is purple. I can count from one to ten in English. Learning colours and numbers is fun and useful.
items.zh: 我们周围有许多颜色。天空是蓝色的，草是绿色的。我最喜欢的颜色是紫色。我能用英语从一数到十。学习颜色和数字既有趣又实用。

items.text: I invite my friends to my party.
items.zh: 我邀请朋友来参加我的聚会。

groups.title: 外研社（一起/三起） · 生日与节日 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Yesterday was my birthday. My mother made a big cake with ten candles. I invited my friends to the party. We sang songs and I blew out the candles. I got many gifts and cards. It was a happy day for me.
items.zh: 昨天是我的生日。妈妈做了一个有十支蜡烛的大蛋糕。我邀请朋友来聚会。我们唱歌，我吹灭了蜡烛。我收到很多礼物和卡片。这对我来说是快乐的一天。

My legs are strong because I run every day.
items.zh: 我的腿很强壮，因为我每天跑步。

groups.title: 外研社（一起/三起） · 身体与健康 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Our body has many parts. We have a head, two eyes, two ears, a nose and a mouth. Our hands help us write and our legs help us run. We should wash our hands and keep our body clean every day. A healthy body makes us happy.
items.zh: 我们的身体有很多部位。我们有头、两只眼睛、两只耳朵、一个鼻子和一张嘴。手帮我们写字，腿帮我们跑步。我们应该洗手并每天保持身体清洁。健康的身体让我们快乐。

The bell rings and we stand in a line.
We read books together in the library.
items.zh: 我们一起在图书馆看书。

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: My school day starts at eight. When the bell rings, we stand in a line and go to the classroom. We do exercise on the playground every morning. At noon we have lunch in the canteen. In the afternoon we read together in the library. I like my busy school life.
items.zh: 我的学校生活八点开始。铃响时我们排队进教室。每天早上我们在操场锻炼。中午我们在食堂吃午饭。下午我们一起在图书馆看书。我喜欢我忙碌的学校生活。

items.zh: 正方形有四条边和四个角。

items.text: I draw a red star on the paper.
items.zh: 我在纸上画一颗红色的星星。

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Shapes are everywhere in our life. A ball is a circle and it is round. A window is often a square with four sides. We can see a triangle in a slice of pizza and an oval in an egg. I like to draw stars and hearts in red and yellow.
items.zh: 形状在我们生活中无处不在。球是圆形的。窗户常常是有四条边的正方形。我们在一片披萨里看到三角形，在鸡蛋里看到椭圆形。我喜欢用红色和黄色画星星和心形。

Grapes are sweet and lemons are sour.
items.zh: 葡萄是甜的，柠檬是酸的。

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Fruit is good for our health. Apples and bananas are sweet and easy to eat. Grapes are small and juicy. In summer I like mangoes and peaches best. My mother makes fresh juice every morning. Eating fruit every day keeps me healthy.
items.zh: 水果对健康有益。苹果和香蕉又甜又方便吃。葡萄又小又多汁。夏天我最喜欢芒果和桃子。妈妈每天早上做新鲜果汁。每天吃水果让我保持健康。

groups.title: 译林版（牛津） · 学校生活 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按课标话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

items.text: We have a short break after each lesson.
items.zh: 每节课后我们有一次短暂休息。

items.text: Our group is doing a science project.
items.zh: 我们小组正在做一个科学项目。

items.text: I practise speaking English to improve it.
items.zh: 我练习说英语来提高它。

groups.title: 译林版（牛津） · 学校生活 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: School life is busy but interesting. We study many subjects and do homework every day. After the break we work in groups on projects. I join the English club and practise speaking with my classmates. All this helps me improve quickly.
items.zh: 学校生活忙碌但有趣。我们每天学习很多科目、做作业。休息后我们分组做项目。我参加英语社团，和同学练习口语。这些都帮我快速提高。

groups.title: 译林版（牛津） · 动物与宠物 · 核心词汇

items.zh: 我的宠物猫有一条长尾巴。

items.text: I feed my rabbit carrots every day.
Pandas eat bamboo at the zoo.

groups.title: 译林版（牛津） · 动物与宠物 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: I love animals very much. My pet cat sleeps on my bed and my pet rabbit likes carrots. I feed them every day and clean their home. At the zoo I watch pandas eating bamboo slowly. Animals are our good friends and we should care for them.
items.zh: 我非常喜爱动物。我的宠物猫睡在我的床上，宠物兔喜欢胡萝卜。我每天喂它们并打扫它们的窝。在动物园我看熊猫慢慢地吃竹子。动物是我们的好朋友，我们应该爱护它们。

groups.title: 译林版（牛津） · 家庭与房间 · 核心词汇

There is a big bed and a lamp in my bedroom.
items.zh: 我的卧室里有一张大床和一盏台灯。

items.text: Please open the door and the window.

groups.title: 译林版（牛津） · 家庭与房间 · 阅读段落
groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: My home is warm and comfortable. There is a kitchen, a living room, a bathroom and two bedrooms. In my bedroom there is a big bed, a small lamp and a shelf for my books. We put a soft sofa in the living room. Home is my favourite place in the world.
items.zh: 我的家温暖又舒适。有厨房、客厅、浴室和两间卧室。我的卧室里有一张大床、一盏小台灯和一个放书的架子。客厅里放着一张柔软的沙发。家是世界上我最喜欢的地方。

groups.title: 沪教牛津 · 动物与身体 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按课标话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.desc: 围绕本主题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The elephant uses its long trunk to drink.
Birds use their wings to fly.
Monkeys can climb trees very fast.

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Animals have amazing bodies. An elephant uses its long trunk to drink water and pick up food. A giraffe has a very long neck to reach high leaves. Birds use their wings to fly and fish use their tails to swim. Each body part helps the animal live well.
items.zh: 动物有奇妙的身体。大象用长鼻子喝水和取食。长颈鹿有很长的脖子去够高处的树叶。鸟用翅膀飞行，鱼用尾巴游泳。每个身体部位都帮助动物更好地生存。

items.text: Family and friends make life warm. My grandma tells me stories and my grandpa takes me to the park. I share my toys with my cousin and we play together. Our neighbour often helps my mother. Caring for each other makes everyone happy.
items.zh: 家人和朋友让生活温暖。奶奶给我讲故事，爷爷带我去公园。我和表弟分享玩具，一起玩耍。我们的邻居常帮妈妈。互相关心让每个人都快乐。

The teacher writes on the blackboard with chalk.

items.text: Our classroom is bright and tidy. There is a big blackboard at the front and a screen for the projector. We put our bags in the cupboard and sit in our seats. When we have a question, we raise our hands. Everyone keeps quiet during the lesson.
items.zh: 我们的教室明亮整洁。前面有一块大黑板和一块投影屏幕。我们把书包放进柜子，坐在座位上。有问题时我们举手。上课时大家都保持安静。

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Staying healthy needs good habits. I sleep eight hours every night and do exercise every morning. I drink enough water and eat less sugar. When I feel ill, I rest at home and see a doctor if needed. Healthy habits give me energy to study and play.
items.zh: 保持健康需要好习惯。我每晚睡八小时，每天早上锻炼。我喝足够的水，少吃糖。生病时我在家休息，必要时去看医生。健康的习惯给我学习和玩耍的能量。

groups.desc: 一段连贯短文，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: The weather decides what we do outside. On sunny days we have a picnic in the park or cycle around the lake. When it is windy I fly a kite with my father. On rainy days I wear a raincoat and jump in puddles. Every season has its fun activities.
items.zh: 天气决定我们在外面做什么。晴天我们在公园野餐或环湖骑车。有风时我和爸爸放风筝。雨天我穿雨衣、踩水坑。每个季节都有有趣的活动。

items.text: Everyone needs a hobby. My hobby is playing basketball with my friends after school. Our coach teaches us how to work as a team. When I feel tired, I play the guitar at home to relax. Hobbies make our life colourful.
items.zh: 每个人都需要爱好。我的爱好是放学后和朋友打篮球。教练教我们如何团队合作。累的时候我在家弹吉他放松。爱好让我们的生活丰富多彩。

On weekends I get up late and relax.
items.zh: 周末我起得晚，放松一下。

groups.title: 人教版 Go for it · 日常作息与时间 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: My daily routine is simple. On weekdays my alarm wakes me up at six. I brush my teeth, eat breakfast and hurry to school. I usually fall asleep before ten at night. On weekends I get up late and enjoy a slower schedule.
items.zh: 我的日常作息很简单。工作日闹钟六点叫醒我，我刷牙、吃早餐、匆忙上学。我通常十点前睡着。周末我起得晚，享受更慢的节奏。

items.text: Can I try a bigger size?
The shop gives a discount to students.

groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: I like shopping with my mother on weekends. We compare prices in different shops before we buy. When something is too expensive, we look for a discount. The cashier gives us a receipt and we check it carefully. Shopping wisely helps us save money.
items.zh: 我喜欢周末和妈妈购物。买东西前我们比较不同店的价格。太贵时我们找折扣。收银员给我们收据，我们仔细核对。明智购物帮我们省钱。

groups.title: 人教版 Go for it · 健康与就医 · 核心词汇

items.text: I have a fever and a bad headache.
The doctor told me to rest and drink water.
items.zh: 医生让我休息并多喝水。

items.text: It takes a week to recover from the flu.
items.zh: 流感需要一周才能康复。

groups.title: 人教版 Go for it · 健康与就医 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Last week I caught a bad cold. I had a fever, a headache and a cough. My mother made an appointment with the doctor. The nurse took my temperature and gave me some medicine. After a few days of rest I began to recover.
items.zh: 上周我得了重感冒。我发烧、头痛、咳嗽。妈妈帮我预约了医生。护士量了体温，给了我一些药。休息几天后我开始康复。

items.text: I once visited my grandparents in the countryside.
items.zh: 我曾经去乡下看望爷爷奶奶。

items.text: That trip was an unforgettable experience.
items.zh: 那次旅行是难忘的经历。

items.text: I treasure the happy memories of my childhood.
items.zh: 我珍视童年的快乐回忆。

groups.title: 人教版 Go for it · 过去的经历 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Childhood memories stay with us forever. I once took a long journey to my grandparents’ village. The train was slow but the view was beautiful. Suddenly I realized how much I loved the quiet countryside. That trip is an unforgettable treasure.
items.zh: 童年记忆永远留在我们心中。我曾经坐长途车去爷爷奶奶的村庄。火车很慢但风景很美。突然我意识到自己多么喜欢安静的乡村。那次旅行是难忘的珍宝。

items.zh: 我们为学校组织了一场演讲比赛。

items.text: I felt nervous on the stage but became confident soon.
items.zh: 我在台上很紧张，但很快变得自信。

groups.title: 外研社 · 校园生活与社团 · 阅读语篇

items.text: School clubs make our life rich. I am a member of the English club. Last month we organised a speaking competition. I stood on the stage in front of a large audience. At first I was nervous, but soon I became confident and spoke well.
items.zh: 学校社团让生活丰富。我是英语社团的成员。上个月我们组织了一场演讲比赛。我站在台上，面对很多观众。一开始我很紧张，但很快就自信起来，讲得很好。

items.text: Please show your ticket before you board.

items.text: Travelling by train is comfortable. I bought a ticket to the city and waited at the station. The railway route passes green fields and small towns. Passengers chat or look out of the window. When we reached our destination, I felt excited and happy.
items.zh: 坐火车旅行很舒服。我买了一张去城里的票，在车站等车。铁路线经过绿色的田野和小镇。乘客聊天或看窗外。到达目的地时我感到兴奋和开心。

I try to eat less fried food and sugar.
items.zh: 我尽量少吃油炸食品和糖。

items.text: Homemade meals are better than fast food.

groups.title: 外研社 · 食物与饮食习惯 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Good eating habits are important. I used to love fried food and sweet snacks. Now I try to keep a balanced diet with more vegetables and less sugar. My mother cooks homemade meals full of nutrition. Since I changed my habits, I feel much better.
items.zh: 良好的饮食习惯很重要。我以前喜欢油炸食品和甜零食。现在我尽量保持均衡饮食，多吃蔬菜少吃糖。妈妈做的家常菜营养丰富。改变习惯后我感觉好多了。

groups.title: 外研社 · 科学与技术 · 核心词汇

items.text: We did an interesting experiment in the laboratory.
items.zh: 我们在实验室做了一个有趣的实验。

items.text: Scientists discover new things every year.
items.zh: 科学家每年都有新发现。

items.text: Satellites send data back to the earth.

groups.title: 外研社 · 科学与技术 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Science changes our world. In the laboratory we do experiments and record data carefully. Scientists do research to discover new medicines and invent useful machines. Robots work in factories and satellites circle the earth. I want to study science when I grow up.
items.zh: 科学改变我们的世界。在实验室我们做实验并认真记录数据。科学家做研究以发现新药、发明有用的机器。机器人在工厂工作，卫星环绕地球。我长大后想学科学。

groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: I admire the scientist for her courage.
items.zh: 我钦佩那位科学家的勇气。

items.text: He achieved success through hard effort.
Failure taught him more than success.
items.zh: 失败教给他的比成功更多。

groups.title: 外研社 · 名人故事 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: I like reading biographies of famous people. Their stories show that talent is not enough; effort and courage matter more. Many pioneers failed many times before they achieved success. Their lives give me inspiration when I face difficulties.
items.zh: 我喜欢读名人传记。他们的故事说明光有天赋不够，努力和勇气更重要。许多先驱在成功前失败过很多次。他们的人生在我遇到困难时给我鼓舞。

items.zh: 我们应该保护稀有动物。
回收塑料瓶能节约资源。

items.text: Pollution destroys the habitat of many species.
items.zh: 污染破坏了许多物种的栖息地。

groups.title: 译林版 · 人与自然 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: People and nature must live in balance. Pollution and plastic waste destroy the habitat of many species. Rare animals can hardly survive when forests disappear. If we recycle and reduce waste, we give nature a chance to heal. Protecting nature means protecting ourselves.
items.zh: 人与自然必须平衡共处。污染和塑料垃圾破坏许多物种的栖息地。森林消失时稀有动物难以生存。如果我们回收并减少废物，就给自然一个恢复的机会。保护自然就是保护我们自己。

items.zh: 家人聚在一起吃团圆饭。

items.text: We decorate the house with red lanterns.
items.zh: 我们用红灯笼装饰房子。

items.text: Fireworks are a symbol of happiness.

groups.title: 译林版 · 节日与习俗 · 阅读语篇

items.text: Festivals bring families together. During the Spring Festival we decorate our house with red lanterns and visit relatives. At night the whole family gathers for a reunion dinner. We watch fireworks and children receive red packets. These customs keep our tradition alive.
items.zh: 节日让家人团聚。春节期间我们用红灯笼装饰房子、走亲戚。晚上全家聚在一起吃团圆饭。我们看烟花，孩子们收到红包。这些习俗让我们的传统延续。

groups.title: 译林版 · 音乐与艺术 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: We went to a concert last night.
items.zh: 我们昨晚去听了一场音乐会。

items.text: The gallery shows modern paintings and sculptures.
items.zh: 画廊展出现代绘画和雕塑。

groups.title: 译林版 · 音乐与艺术 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Art makes life beautiful. My sister plays the violin and I love the melody and rhythm of her music. Last night we went to a concert and the performers played wonderfully. At weekends we visit the gallery to see paintings and sculptures. Art helps us become creative.
items.zh: 艺术让生活美好。我姐姐拉小提琴，我喜欢她音乐的旋律和节奏。昨晚我们去听音乐会，演奏者们表演得很精彩。周末我们去画廊看画和雕塑。艺术让我们变得有创造力。

groups.title: 译林版 · 社交媒体与沟通 · 核心词汇

items.text: Social media helps us contact friends far away.
items.zh: 社交媒体帮助我们联系远方的朋友。

items.text: Do not share your private information online.
items.zh: 不要在网上分享你的私人信息。

items.text: Please reply to my message when you are free.

groups.title: 译林版 · 社交媒体与沟通 · 阅读语篇

items.text: Social media brings people closer, but we must be careful. We can send messages, share photos and upload videos to keep in touch. However, people sometimes misunderstand short comments. We should protect our privacy and think before we post. Using the network wisely is an important skill.
items.zh: 社交媒体拉近人与人之间的距离，但我们必须小心。我们可以发消息、分享照片、上传视频来保持联系。但人们有时会误解简短的评论。我们应该保护隐私，发帖前三思。明智地使用网络是一项重要技能。

groups.title: 译林版 · 志愿服务 · 核心词汇

items.text: I work as a volunteer in our community.
We donated books and clothes to the shelter.
items.zh: 我们向庇护所捐赠了书和衣服。

groups.title: 译林版 · 志愿服务 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Volunteering makes our community warmer. Every month I help at a home for the elderly. We talk with them, clean the rooms and sometimes sing together. My friends organised a charity sale and donated the money to a shelter. Kindness is always worthwhile.
items.zh: 志愿服务让我们的社区更温暖。每个月我在养老院帮忙。我们陪老人聊天、打扫房间，有时一起唱歌。朋友们组织了一次义卖，把钱捐给了一个庇护所。善意永远是值得的。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 家庭与代沟 · 核心词汇

groups.title: 北师大版 · 家庭与代沟 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: My parents are strict but they love me.
items.zh: 我的父母很严格但他们爱我。

items.text: We should respect each other’s opinions.
items.zh: 我们应该尊重彼此的看法。

items.text: Good communication helps close the generation gap.
items.zh: 良好的沟通有助于缩小代沟。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 家庭与代沟 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: The generation gap can cause quarrels at home. Teenagers want freedom while parents worry about safety. I used to argue with my mother, but now we try to communicate patiently. When we respect each other’s opinions, our relationship becomes better.
items.zh: 代沟会在家里引发争吵。青少年想要自由，父母担心安全。我以前常和妈妈争吵，但现在我们努力耐心沟通。当我们尊重彼此的看法，关系就会变好。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 学习方法与习惯 · 核心词汇

groups.title: 北师大版 · 学习方法与习惯 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: I take notes and review them every evening.
A quiet place helps me concentrate.
items.zh: 安静的地方帮我集中注意力。

items.text: Good methods make study more efficient.

groups.title: 北师大版 · 学习方法与习惯 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Good study habits bring progress. Before class I preview the new lesson and after class I review my notes. I make a weekly schedule and write a short summary of each subject. When my phone distracts me, I put it away. Efficient methods save time and improve memory.
items.zh: 良好的学习习惯带来进步。课前我预习新课，课后复习笔记。我制定每周计划，并为每门课写简短总结。手机让我分心时我就把它放远。高效的方法节省时间、增强记忆。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 城市与乡村 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 城市与乡村 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The city is convenient but crowded.
The countryside is quiet and peaceful.
I miss the fresh air of my village.
items.zh: 我想念村庄里的新鲜空气。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 城市与乡村 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Life in the city and the countryside is different. The city is convenient with shops and buses, but the traffic is heavy and the streets are crowded. My grandparents live in a small village where the fields are green and the air is fresh. I enjoy the peaceful life there.
items.zh: 城市和乡村的生活不同。城市有商店和公交，很便利，但交通拥挤、街道喧闹。我的爷爷奶奶住在一个小村庄，田野碧绿、空气清新。我喜欢那里宁静的生活。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 安全与急救 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 安全与急救 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Cover the burn with a clean bandage.
items.zh: 用干净绷带盖住烧伤处。

items.text: Our school has a fire drill every term.
items.zh: 我们学校每学期有一次消防演练。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 安全与急救 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Safety skills can save lives. Our school holds a fire drill every term and we learn how to escape quickly. In an emergency, the most important thing is to stay calm. If someone is bleeding, we cover the wound with a bandage and call an ambulance. Preventing danger is better than dealing with it.
items.zh: 安全技能能救命。我们学校每学期举行消防演练，学习如何快速逃生。紧急情况下最重要的是保持冷静。如果有人流血，我们用绷带盖住伤口并叫救护车。预防危险胜于处理危险。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 梦想与职业 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 梦想与职业 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: My dream is to become an engineer.
items.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名工程师。

items.text: This career requires skill and patience.
items.zh: 这个职业需要技能和耐心。

items.text: With passion and effort, I will achieve my goal.
items.zh: 有热情和努力，我会实现目标。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 梦想与职业 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Everyone has a dream for the future. I want to become a designer because I love drawing and creating. My friend dreams of being a lawyer. Any career requires skills, passion and hard effort. I study hard now so that I can achieve my dream one day.
items.zh: 每个人都有对未来的梦想。我想成为设计师，因为我喜欢画画和创造。我的朋友梦想成为律师。任何职业都需要技能、热情和努力。我现在努力学习，以便有一天能实现梦想。

groups.title: 人教版 · 文化交流 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Cultural exchange helps us understand each other.
items.zh: 文化交流帮助我们相互理解。
我们应该尊重文化多样性。

items.text: It takes time to adapt to life abroad.
items.zh: 适应国外生活需要时间。

groups.title: 人教版 · 文化交流 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Cultural exchange is valuable in a global world. When we study abroad, we meet different customs and values. Misunderstandings may happen, but respect and patience solve most problems. Adapting to a new culture also helps us understand our own identity better.
items.zh: 文化交流在全球化世界很有价值。出国学习时我们会遇到不同的习俗和价值观。误会可能发生，但尊重和耐心能解决大部分问题。适应新文化也帮我们更好地理解自己的身份认同。

groups.title: 人教版 · 科技与未来 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 人教版 · 科技与未来 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Artificial intelligence is changing our daily life.
items.zh: 人工智能正在改变我们的日常生活。
自动化可能取代一些工作。

items.text: We should think about the ethical risks of new technology.
items.zh: 我们应该思考新技术的伦理风险。

groups.title: 人教版 · 科技与未来 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Technology brings both benefits and risks. Artificial intelligence and automation make work faster, but they may also replace some careers. Scientists make breakthroughs in medicine every year. As we enjoy these benefits, we must also discuss the ethical questions they raise.
items.zh: 科技带来好处也带来风险。人工智能和自动化让工作更快，但也可能取代一些职业。科学家每年在医学上取得突破。享受这些好处的同时，我们也必须讨论它们引发的伦理问题。

groups.title: 人教版 · 环境保护 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 人教版 · 环境保护 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Renewable energy is cleaner than coal.
items.zh: 可再生能源比煤更清洁。

items.text: Sustainable development protects resources for the future.
items.zh: 可持续发展为未来保护资源。

groups.title: 人教版 · 环境保护 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Global warming is one of the biggest challenges we face. To slow climate change, countries must reduce carbon emissions and use renewable energy such as wind and solar power. Sustainable development means using resources wisely. Good policy and daily habits together can protect our environment.
items.zh: 全球变暖是我们面临的最大挑战之一。为减缓气候变化，各国必须减少碳排放，使用风能和太阳能等可再生能源。可持续发展意味着明智地利用资源。好的政策和日常习惯共同能保护我们的环境。

groups.title: 人教版 · 人物榜样 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 人教版 · 人物榜样 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: My role model is a teacher who devoted her life to education.
items.zh: 我的榜样是一位把一生献给教育的老师。

items.text: Ordinary people can do extraordinary things.
items.zh: 普通人可以做出不平凡的事。

items.text: His perseverance through hardship inspired many people.
items.zh: 他在困境中的坚持鼓舞了很多人。

groups.title: 人教版 · 人物榜样 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Role models show us what we can become. They are often ordinary people who persevere through hardship. My role model is a doctor who devoted her life to helping poor villages. She is humble about her achievements, but her legacy inspires many young people to serve others.
items.zh: 榜样告诉我们能成为什么样的人。他们常常是在困境中坚持的普通人。我的榜样是一位把一生献给帮助贫困乡村的医生。她对自己的成就很谦逊，但她留下的精神鼓舞了许多年轻人去服务他人。

groups.title: 人教版 · 艺术与审美 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 人教版 · 艺术与审美 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: I appreciate classical music and modern painting.
items.zh: 我欣赏古典音乐和现代绘画。

items.text: Art creates an emotional connection between people.
items.zh: 艺术在人与人之间建立情感联系。

groups.title: 人教版 · 艺术与审美 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Art develops our sense of beauty. At an exhibition we can see classical and modern works, from realistic sculptures to abstract paintings. Critics may disagree about what counts as a masterpiece, but everyone can feel the emotion in art. Creativity and appreciation make life richer.
items.zh: 艺术培养我们的美感。在展览上我们能看到古典和现代作品，从写实的雕塑到抽象的绘画。评论家对什么是杰作可能有分歧，但每个人都能感受到艺术中的情感。创造与欣赏让生活更丰富。

groups.title: 外研社 · 社会问题 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 外研社 · 社会问题 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Poverty and inequality remain serious problems.
items.zh: 贫困和不平等仍是严重问题。

items.text: The gap between urban and rural areas is narrowing.

items.zh: 社会应该保护弱势群体。

groups.title: 外研社 · 社会问题 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Every society faces difficult issues. Poverty, unemployment and inequality affect millions of people. The gap between urban and rural areas creates unfair chances in education and work. Governments need reform and stronger welfare systems. Charity helps, but justice requires real change.
items.zh: 每个社会都面临难题。贫困、失业和不平等影响着数百万人。城乡差距造成教育和工作的机会不公。政府需要改革和更强的福利体系。慈善有帮助，但公正需要真正的改变。

groups.title: 外研社 · 健康生活 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 外研社 · 健康生活 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Mental health is as important as physical health.
items.zh: 心理健康和身体健康同样重要。
规律锻炼能预防许多疾病。

items.text: Too much stress causes anxiety and poor sleep.
items.zh: 压力过大会导致焦虑和睡眠不佳。

groups.title: 外研社 · 健康生活 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: A healthy lifestyle needs balance. We should eat food with good nutrition, exercise regularly and sleep enough. Stress at school or work can cause anxiety, so we must learn to relax. Taking care of both mental and physical health helps prevent disease and keeps our immune system strong.
items.zh: 健康的生活方式需要平衡。我们应该吃有营养的食物、规律锻炼、充足睡眠。学校或工作的压力会导致焦虑，所以我们要学会放松。兼顾心理和身体健康有助于预防疾病、增强免疫系统。

groups.title: 外研社 · 探险与旅行 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 外研社 · 探险与旅行 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The expedition reached the summit after three days.
items.zh: 探险队三天后登上了山顶。

items.text: They travelled through remote desert and jungle.
items.zh: 他们穿越了偏远的沙漠和丛林。

items.text: Good equipment is necessary to survive in the wild.
items.zh: 在野外生存需要好装备。

groups.title: 外研社 · 探险与旅行 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Adventure teaches us courage. An expedition to a remote mountain or desert requires careful planning and good equipment. The landscape may be beautiful, but the challenge is real. Those who are brave enough to face it often return with a deeper understanding of themselves.
items.zh: 探险教会我们勇气。去偏远的山脉或沙漠探险需要周密计划和良好装备。风景可能很美，但挑战是真实的。敢于面对的人往往会带着对自我更深的理解归来。

groups.title: 外研社 · 文学与阅读 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 外研社 · 文学与阅读 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The novel has interesting characters and a surprising plot.
items.zh: 这本小说人物有趣、情节出人意料。

items.text: Classic literature reflects the society of its time.
items.zh: 古典文学反映了它所处时代的社会。

items.text: Readers may interpret the same story differently.
items.zh: 读者对同一个故事可能有不同的解读。

groups.title: 外研社 · 文学与阅读 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Reading literature opens new worlds. A good novel has memorable characters and a plot that makes us think. Classic works reflect the society in which the author lived. Every reader interprets the story in their own way, and that is what makes literature alive.
items.zh: 阅读文学打开新的世界。好的小说有难忘的人物和引人思考的情节。经典作品反映作者所处的社会。每个读者以自己的方式解读故事，这正是文学的生命力所在。

groups.title: 外研社 · 媒体与新闻 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 外研社 · 媒体与新闻 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: A good journalist verifies information before reporting.
items.zh: 好记者在报道前会核实信息。
有些新闻标题具有误导性。

items.text: We should check the source of the news.
items.zh: 我们应该核实新闻来源。

groups.title: 外研社 · 媒体与新闻 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: In the age of social media, news spreads fast. But not every report is reliable, and headlines can be misleading. A responsible journalist checks the source and verifies facts before publishing. As the audience, we should read critically and be aware of bias and influence.
items.zh: 在社交媒体时代，新闻传播很快。但并非每篇报道都可靠，标题也可能误导人。负责任的记者在发布前会核实来源和事实。作为受众，我们应该批判地阅读，注意偏见和影响。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 科学与创新 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 科学与创新 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The experiment gave clear evidence for the theory.
items.zh: 实验为这个理论提供了明确证据。

items.text: Scientists share results with their peers.
items.zh: 科学家与同行分享结果。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 科学与创新 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Innovation begins with curiosity. Scientists form a hypothesis, design an experiment and collect evidence. If the results support the theory, they reach a conclusion and share it with their peers. This method has brought us countless breakthroughs, from electricity to modern medicine.
items.zh: 创新始于好奇心。科学家提出假设、设计实验、收集证据。如果结果支持理论，他们得出结论并与同行分享。这个方法给我们带来了无数突破，从电到现代医学。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 人生选择 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 人生选择 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: We must set our priorities before deciding.
items.zh: 做决定前我们要确定优先事项。

items.text: A mature person takes responsibility for their decisions.
items.zh: 成熟的人为自己的决定负责。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 人生选择 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Life is full of choices. When we choose a path, we also accept its consequences. Sometimes we must compromise between what we want and what we value most. Taking a risk can bring new opportunities. What matters is to decide responsibly and not live with regret.
items.zh: 人生充满选择。当我们选择一条路，也接受了它的后果。有时我们必须在想要的东西和最看重的东西之间妥协。冒险能带来新机会。重要的是负责任地决定，不带着遗憾生活。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 全球议题 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 全球议题 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.zh: 全球问题需要国际合作。

items.text: The summit discussed hunger and epidemic control.
items.zh: 峰会讨论了饥饿与流行病防控。

items.text: Countries signed a treaty on climate and security.
items.zh: 各国签署了一项关于气候与安全的条约。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 全球议题 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Some problems cross all borders. Hunger, epidemics and migration affect every region of the world. No single country can solve them alone, so international cooperation is essential. Through treaties, summits and organisations, nations provide aid and work together for common security.
items.zh: 有些问题跨越所有国界。饥饿、流行病和移民影响着世界每个地区。没有哪个国家能独自解决，因此国际合作至关重要。通过条约、峰会和组织，各国提供援助，共同致力于共同安全。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 心理学与情绪 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 心理学与情绪 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Learning to cope with pressure is important.

items.zh: 正念呼吸可以减轻焦虑。

items.text: Empathy helps us understand others’ emotions.
items.zh: 同理心帮助我们理解他人的情绪。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 心理学与情绪 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Understanding emotions improves our well-being. Pressure at school can cause anxiety and change our mood. Simple habits help us cope: mindful breathing, regular exercise and honest conversation. Empathy allows us to understand how others feel, and that understanding motivates kinder behaviour.
items.zh: 理解情绪能提升我们的幸福感。学校的压力会导致焦虑、改变情绪。简单的习惯帮我们应对：正念呼吸、规律锻炼、坦诚交流。同理心让我们理解他人的感受，这种理解会激发更友善的行为。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 传统与现代 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 传统与现代 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: We should preserve our cultural heritage.
items.zh: 我们应该保护文化遗产。

items.text: Ancient crafts can still be valuable today.
items.zh: 古老的手工艺在今天仍有价值。

items.text: Traditions must adapt to modern life.
items.zh: 传统必须适应现代生活。

groups.title: 北师大版 · 传统与现代 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Tradition and modern life can live together. Ancient customs give us a sense of identity, while contemporary ideas bring new chances. We should preserve our heritage, such as old crafts and ceremonies, but also let them adapt. What we truly keep is not the form but the value behind it.
items.zh: 传统与现代生活可以共存。古老的习俗给我们身份认同感，而当代思想带来新机遇。我们应该保护遗产，如古老手工艺和仪式，但也让它们适应变化。我们真正保留的不是形式，而是其背后的价值。

groups.title: 译林版 · 自然奇观 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 译林版 · 自然奇观 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The canyon is a breathtaking natural wonder.
items.zh: 这个峡谷是令人惊叹的自然奇观。

items.text: The glacier moves very slowly down the mountain.
We saw coral and colourful fish in the sea.
items.zh: 我们在海里看到了珊瑚和彩色鱼群。

groups.title: 译林版 · 自然奇观 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: The earth is full of natural wonders. Deep canyons, high waterfalls and vast glaciers show the power of nature. Inside a cave you may find crystal-clear pools, and under the sea coral reefs glow with colour. Such breathtaking landscapes remind us how small we are.
items.zh: 地球充满自然奇观。深邃的峡谷、高悬的瀑布、广阔的冰川展现自然的力量。在洞穴里你能找到清澈见底的水潭，海底的珊瑚礁色彩斑斓。这般令人惊叹的景观提醒我们有多渺小。

groups.title: 译林版 · 语言学习 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 译林版 · 语言学习 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Reading in context helps me memorise new vocabulary.
items.zh: 在语境中阅读帮我记住新词。

items.text: She speaks fluent English with a clear accent.
Immersion is the fastest way to learn a language.
items.zh: 沉浸式是学语言最快的方式。

groups.title: 译林版 · 语言学习 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Learning a language takes time and practice. We need vocabulary, grammar and, above all, the courage to speak. Reading in context is better than memorising word lists. If you can immerse yourself in the language, progress comes faster. Being bilingual opens many doors.
items.zh: 学一门语言需要时间和练习。我们需要词汇、语法，最重要的是开口的勇气。在语境中阅读胜过背单词表。如果能沉浸在语言中，进步会更快。掌握双语能打开很多门。

groups.title: 译林版 · 历史事件 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 译林版 · 历史事件 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Archaeologists found ruins of an ancient empire.
items.zh: 考古学家发现了一个古代帝国的遗迹。

items.text: The treaty ended a long war.
items.zh: 这项条约结束了一场长期战争。

items.text: Documents give evidence about life in that era.
items.zh: 文献为那个时代的生活提供了证据。

groups.title: 译林版 · 历史事件 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: History helps us understand the present. Archaeologists study ruins and old documents to learn how people lived in another era. Empires rise through conquest and fall through slow decline. By studying the evidence, we see patterns that repeat across centuries.
items.zh: 历史帮助我们理解现在。考古学家研究遗迹和古文献，了解另一个时代人们如何生活。帝国因征服而兴起，因缓慢衰落而灭亡。通过研究证据，我们看到几个世纪以来重复出现的规律。

groups.title: 译林版 · 体育精神 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 译林版 · 体育精神 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The champion won through determination and discipline.
items.zh: 冠军靠决心和自律取胜。

items.text: Fair competition means respecting your opponent.
items.zh: 公平竞争意味着尊重对手。

items.text: Defeat teaches more than easy victory.
items.zh: 失败比轻易的胜利教得更多。

groups.title: 译林版 · 体育精神 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Sports teach us more than winning. A great athlete needs discipline, determination and respect for opponents. Teamwork turns individual talent into collective strength. Defeat is painful, but those who persist learn lessons that easy victory can never teach.
items.zh: 体育教给我们的不止是胜利。伟大的运动员需要自律、决心和对对手的尊重。团队合作把个人天赋转化为集体力量。失败是痛苦的，但坚持的人学到的东西，是轻易的胜利永远教不会的。

groups.title: 译林版 · 太空探索 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 译林版 · 太空探索 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The rocket will launch next month.
Astronauts orbit the earth in the space station.
items.zh: 宇航员在空间站绕地球飞行。

items.text: Telescopes help us see distant galaxies.
items.zh: 望远镜帮我们看遥远的星系。

groups.title: 译林版 · 太空探索 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Space exploration expands our view of the universe. A rocket launch requires years of preparation, and astronauts train hard for each mission. From orbit they look back at our small blue planet. Telescopes now show us galaxies far away, and every answer brings new questions.
items.zh: 太空探索拓展我们对宇宙的认识。火箭发射需要数年准备，宇航员为每次任务刻苦训练。在轨道上他们回望我们小小的蓝色星球。望远镜如今向我们展示遥远的星系，而每一个答案都带来新的问题。

levels.desc: 大学阶段常见话题，词汇与语篇并重。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 教育学习 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 教育学习 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: The university offers a wide range of academic courses.
items.zh: 这所大学提供广泛的学术课程。

items.text: She won a scholarship to study abroad.
items.zh: 她获得了出国留学的奖学金。

items.text: Graduates face fierce competition in the job market.
items.zh: 毕业生面临激烈的就业竞争。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 教育学习 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Higher education shapes both knowledge and character. On campus students attend lectures, join seminars and finish assignments. A degree is important, but research experience and independent thinking matter just as much. Scholarships help talented students whose families cannot pay the tuition.
items.zh: 高等教育塑造知识与品格。在校园里学生听讲座、参加研讨、完成作业。学位重要，但研究经历和独立思考同样重要。奖学金帮助那些家庭无力支付学费的优秀学生。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 科技影响 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 科技影响 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Smartphones bring great convenience to daily life.
items.zh: 智能手机给日常生活带来极大便利。

items.text: We should protect our personal data online.
items.zh: 我们应该保护网上个人数据。

items.text: Overdependence on digital devices can be harmful.
items.zh: 过度依赖数字设备可能有害。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 科技影响 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Digital technology has changed how we live and work. Smartphones and applications bring convenience, but they also create dependence. Companies collect huge amounts of data, so privacy becomes a serious concern. The real challenge is to enjoy the benefits of innovation while keeping control of our own attention.
items.zh: 数字技术改变了我们的生活和工作方式。智能手机和应用带来便利，但也造成依赖。企业收集大量数据，因此隐私成为严重问题。真正的挑战是在享受创新好处的同时，掌控自己的注意力。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 环境与健康 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 环境与健康 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Air pollution can cause respiratory diseases.
items.zh: 空气污染会导致呼吸道疾病。

items.text: Long-term exposure to chemicals is dangerous.
items.zh: 长期接触化学品是危险的。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 环境与健康 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Environmental problems affect public health directly. Industrial emissions and chemical exposure increase chronic and respiratory diseases, especially in urban areas. Prevention costs far less than treatment. Cleaner production, better hygiene and improved nutrition together can reduce the burden on hospitals.
items.zh: 环境问题直接影响公众健康。工业排放和化学品接触增加了慢性病和呼吸道疾病，尤其在城市地区。预防的成本远低于治疗。更清洁的生产、更好的卫生和营养共同能减轻医院负担。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 职场与就业 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 职场与就业 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: A good resume helps you get an interview.
items.zh: 好的简历帮你获得面试机会。

items.text: Remote work improves productivity for some people.
items.zh: 远程办公对某些人提高了效率。

items.text: The company offers good salary and benefits.
items.zh: 这家公司提供不错的薪资和福利。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 职场与就业 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: A career is more than a salary. Employees look for growth, fair pay and benefits, while employers value productivity and teamwork. A clear resume and good interview skills open the door. Remote work is now common, and many people plan carefully for the day they retire.
items.zh: 职业不只是薪水。员工寻求成长、公平的薪酬和福利，而雇主看重效率和团队合作。清晰的简历和良好的面试技巧是敲门砖。远程办公如今很普遍，许多人为退休那天认真做规划。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 社会生活 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 社会生活 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Trust is the foundation of any community.
items.zh: 信任是任何社区的基础。

items.text: Young people should participate in community activities.
items.zh: 年轻人应该参与社区活动。

items.text: Supporting the elderly builds a harmonious society.
items.zh: 支持老人能建设和谐社会。

groups.title: 四六级（CET-4/6） · 社会生活 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: A healthy society depends on everyday connections. Neighbours who trust each other cooperate more easily. When young people participate in volunteer work, they learn responsibility and support those in need. Caring for the elderly and listening to the younger generation keeps a community in harmony.
items.zh: 健康的社会依赖日常的联系。彼此信任的邻居更容易合作。当年轻人参与志愿工作，他们学会责任并帮助有需要的人。关爱老人、倾听年轻一代，让社区保持和谐。

levels.name: 雅思（IELTS）
levels.desc: 雅思常考话题，适合口语与写作语料积累。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 城市化 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 城市化 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Rapid urbanisation brings both opportunities and problems.
items.zh: 快速的城市化既带来机遇也带来问题。

items.text: Congestion and housing shortages worry many residents.
items.zh: 拥堵和住房短缺困扰着许多居民。

items.text: Better public transport shortens the daily commute.
items.zh: 更好的公共交通缩短了日常通勤。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 城市化 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Urbanisation is changing how we live. People migrate to cities for work, which raises population density and creates housing pressure. Congestion and long commutes reduce quality of life, while skyscrapers and new infrastructure change the skyline. Well-planned suburbs and public facilities can make city life far more liveable.
items.zh: 城市化正在改变我们的生活方式。人们为工作迁往城市，这提高了人口密度、造成住房压力。拥堵和长通勤降低生活质量，而摩天大楼和新基础设施改变了天际线。规划良好的郊区和公共设施能让城市生活宜居得多。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 教育体制 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 教育体制 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Secondary education is compulsory in most countries.
items.zh: 在多数国家中等教育是义务的。

items.text: Some students prefer vocational training to academic study.
items.zh: 有些学生更喜欢职业培训而非学术学习。

items.text: Equity in education remains a difficult goal.
items.zh: 教育公平仍是一个困难的目标。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 教育体制 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Education systems differ, but the aims are similar. Primary and secondary schooling builds basic literacy, while universities develop academic depth. Some students are better suited to vocational training than to examinations. The hardest question is equity: how to give every child the same standard regardless of family income.
items.zh: 教育体制不同，但目标相似。中小学教育打基础读写能力，大学发展学术深度。有些学生更适合职业培训而非考试。最难的问题是公平：如何让每个孩子无论家庭收入都达到同样的标准。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 环境保护 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 环境保护 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Deforestation threatens the habitat of many species.
items.zh: 森林砍伐威胁许多物种的栖息地。
可再生能源减少碳排放。

items.text: Conservation protects biodiversity for future generations.
items.zh: 保护为后代守护生物多样性。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 环境保护 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Protecting the environment is protecting ourselves. Deforestation and pollution destroy habitats and push species toward extinction. Conservation projects try to preserve whole ecosystems rather than single animals. Switching to renewable energy and recycling in daily life are small steps that together protect biodiversity.
items.zh: 保护环境就是保护自己。森林砍伐和污染破坏栖息地，把物种推向灭绝。保护项目试图保护整个生态系统而非单一动物。改用可再生能源和日常回收是小小的步骤，合起来能保护生物多样性。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 文化全球化 · 核心词汇
groups.desc: 按话题整理的高频词，可逐词跟读评分。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 文化全球化 · 实用句型
groups.desc: 围绕本话题核心词的常用表达。

items.text: Globalisation spreads culture but may weaken local traditions.
items.zh: 全球化传播文化，但可能削弱本土传统。

items.text: Cultural diversity makes the world richer.
items.zh: 文化多样性让世界更丰富。

items.text: Cities often show a fusion of foreign and local styles.
items.zh: 城市常展现外来与本土风格的融合。

groups.title: 雅思（IELTS） · 文化全球化 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Globalisation moves ideas, food and music across borders quickly. Some fear it will homogenise culture and erase local identity, while others enjoy the fusion of styles. The healthiest result is to keep our heritage while staying open to outside influence, so diversity survives alongside modern life.
items.zh: 全球化让思想、食物和音乐快速跨越国界。有人担心它会让文化同质化、抹去本土认同，有人则享受风格的融合。最健康的结果是保留自己的遗产，同时对外来影响保持开放，让多样性与现代生活共存。

items.text: A good healthcare system values prevention. Regular check-ups and early diagnosis catch disease before it becomes serious. Vaccines have saved millions of lives, and modern surgery and medicine continue to improve recovery. But access still depends on cost and insurance, which remains a challenge in many countries.
items.zh: 好的医疗体系重视预防。定期体检和早期诊断能在疾病变严重前发现它。疫苗挽救了数百万人的生命，现代外科和药物不断提高康复率。但能否获得医疗服务仍取决于费用和保险，这在许多国家仍是挑战。

items.text: Species adapt to their habitat over many generations.
items.zh: 物种经过许多代适应其栖息地。

items.text: Enzymes help break down proteins in the body.
items.zh: 酶帮助分解体内的蛋白质。

items.text: Biology studies living organisms and how they function. Every organism is built from cells, and genes carry information from one generation to the next. Through evolution, species adapt to their habitat. The relationship between predator and prey shapes whole ecosystems, while enzymes control the chemical reactions that keep cells alive.
items.zh: 生物学研究生物及其运作方式。每个生物都由细胞构成，基因把信息传给下一代。通过进化，物种适应其栖息地。捕食者与猎物的关系塑造整个生态系统，而酶控制着维持细胞存活的化学反应。

items.text: Sediment forms layers that record the earth’s history.
items.zh: 沉积物形成的岩层记录了地球历史。

items.text: Glaciers shape valleys through slow erosion.
items.zh: 冰川通过缓慢侵蚀塑造山谷。

items.text: Fossils in rock layers show how climate changed.
items.zh: 岩层中的化石显示了气候如何变化。

groups.title: 托福（TOEFL） · 地质与气候 · 阅读语篇

items.text: Geology reads the history written in stone. Layers of sediment build up over millions of years, and fossils inside them record past life. Erosion by water and glaciers reshapes the land, while tectonic movement and volcanic magma build new mountains. Together these processes explain how climate has changed across the earth’s long history.
items.zh: 地质学解读写在石头里的历史。沉积层经过数百万年堆积，其中的化石记录了过去的生命。水和冰川的侵蚀重塑大地，而构造运动和火山岩浆造出新山脉。这些过程共同解释了地球漫长历史中气候如何变化。

items.zh: 农业使人们能够建立永久定居点。
贸易把遥远的文明连接起来。

items.text: Archaeologists study artifacts to understand ancient life.
items.zh: 考古学家研究文物以了解古代生活。

groups.title: 托福（TOEFL） · 历史文明 · 阅读语篇
groups.desc: 一段连贯语篇，适合整段朗读与评分。

items.text: Early civilisations began where agriculture could support large settlements. Surplus food allowed trade, and trade connected distant regions. Archaeologists study artifacts, monuments and early script to rebuild these stories. Most empires eventually faced decline, yet their ideas and inventions shaped the world that followed.
items.zh: 早期文明始于农业能够支撑大型定居点的地方。剩余的粮食带来贸易，贸易把遥远地区连接起来。考古学家研究文物、纪念碑和早期文字来重建这些故事。多数帝国最终走向衰落，但它们的思想和发明塑造了后来的世界。

items.text: The experiment measured the response to a stimulus.
items.zh: 实验测量了对刺激的反应。
动机强烈影响人类行为。

groups.title: 托福（TOEFL） · 心理学 · 阅读语篇

items.text: Psychology examines behaviour and the mind. Researchers design experiments to test how perception and memory work, and how people respond to a stimulus. Motivation and emotion guide much of what we do, and social pressure changes behaviour in surprising ways. This research also helps in treating mental disorders.
items.zh: 心理学研究行为与心智。研究者设计实验来检验知觉和记忆如何运作，以及人们如何对刺激作出反应。动机和情绪指引我们的大部分行为，社会压力以令人惊讶的方式改变行为。这项研究也有助于治疗精神障碍。

items.zh: 行星因引力绕太阳运行。

items.text: Telescopes let us observe distant galaxies.
items.zh: 望远镜让我们观察遥远的星系。

items.text: Asteroids and comets pass near our planet.
items.zh: 小行星和彗星从我们星球附近掠过。

groups.title: 托福（TOEFL） · 天文学 · 阅读语篇

items.text: Astronomy asks how the universe works. Planets orbit their star because gravity pulls them inward, and satellites circle larger worlds. With a telescope we can observe galaxies billions of years old. Comets and asteroids that pass near our planet remind us that space is active, not empty.
items.zh: 天文学追问宇宙如何运作。行星因引力向内拉扯而绕恒星运行，卫星环绕更大的天体。用望远镜我们能观察数十亿年历史的星系。掠过我们星球附近的彗星和小行星提醒我们：太空是活跃的，而非空无一物。
